capabilities: Browse and sort vault files in a full-width list view
Filter files by extension, size, date and name tokens
Create, rename, move and delete files and folders
Select, batch-rename and bulk-delete multiple files
Visualise the vault folder structure as a graph or tree
extras: Ships as a single unminified main.js with no build step and a self-contained test script; supports over 30 interface languages; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Manager is, in a sense, a replacement for the file list. The built-in file explorer lives in a narrow sidebar
motivation: The author found the sidebar file explorer too cramped for real note management, so Manager takes the main area instead.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file explorer lives in a narrow sidebar, which makes real file management and tidying up hard.
summary: Wide-view file manager that replaces the narrow sidebar file explorer for sorting, filtering, creating and reorganising vault files.
